title: Culturally Aware and Adapted NLP: A Taxonomy and a Survey of the State of the Art

bias_targets.methodology: Surveying existing evaluation methods in the literature, including culturally adapted Word Embedding Association Tests (WEAT), sentence pair datasets (e.g., CrowS-Pairs adaptations), MMLU-style multiple-choice benchmarks, and probing language models for cultural commonsense and value alignment.

Reviewing studies that measure NLP model performance disparities across linguistic variations (e.g., African American Vernacular English, regional dialects) using dialect-to-standard translations and dialect-specific benchmark evaluations.

Surveying approaches that evaluate model alignment against diverse human values and opinions (e.g., comparing WEIRD vs. non-WEIRD populations) using global attitude surveys, annotator demographic analysis, and sociodemographic prompting.
